Claire (AE): Heads-up: HealthCorp needs an air-gapped POC. Must-haves: vendor or customer-signed bundles, SBOM, deterministic (manual) upgrades, and clear upgrade cadence. Procurement pushes back on monthly invoices. Kickoff Fri.
Ibrahim (SE): Quick feasibility: we can produce signed minibundles and full bundles. Typical sizes: 7B-q4 ~600MB, 13B-q4 ~1.1GB, runtime ~350MB. Recommend minibundles for low-bandwidth sites.
Dana (Infra Eng): Customer-managed signing keys supported but requires key onboarding steps and HSM recommendation. Offline apply is manual: `rw-offline verify --bundle <file>` then `rw-offline apply`. Rollback is snapshot-based and operator-triggered.
Ruth (Solutions Eng): Pricing proposals to draft: Option 1 - annual subscription (incl. X offline bundles/year) invoiced annually; Option 2 - perpetual license + annual maintenance invoiced annually + per-bundle eng fees. Offer add-on: 3 remote assist installs.
Claire (AE): They want exact maintenance day so procurement can block windows. Can we anchor calendars?
Ibrahim (SE): Yes - include "first Wednesday" monthly security patch window and "first Tuesday of each quarter" for model refresh in SOW. We prepare signed minibundles ahead of those dates.
pkg-bot: Created ticket SALES-3088 "HealthCorp airgap POC - packaging, signing, cadence" assigned to Ibrahim, Ruth.
Ruth (Solutions Eng): Action: I'll draft two commercial proposals + sample SOW with calendar anchors by Wed EOD. Ibrahim: please provide minibundle size table and a one-page runbook excerpt. Dana: prepare key-custody checklist for Legal (ETA 48h).
Claire (AE): Thanks team 44d I'll share to HealthCorp prep-docs after we have drafts.
